title: Locker Rental: limit on concurrently open rentals per member
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states the limit on how many locker rentals a single member may hold open at the same time, across any tier and any club.

## Rule
A member may hold up to 2 (two) locker rentals open at the same time, counting a rental in any status other than closed (that is, a rental that has been applied for but not yet activated, one that is active, or one that is past due, all count toward the limit); a third concurrently open rental is not permitted. This reflects that a member may rent lockers at more than one club at the same time.

## Equivalent restatement
- Condition: the member already holds two locker rentals in a status other than closed.
- Judgement: a request to open a third concurrently open rental does not qualify.
- Action: the third rental is not permitted while the first two remain open.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)
- A member with one open rental and no others requests a second: this is within the limit, since holding two open rentals at once is permitted.
- A member who already holds two open rentals (regardless of whether each is applied for, active, or past due) requests a third: this exceeds the limit, since a third concurrently open rental is not permitted.
- A member who has closed one of two previously open rentals, leaving one open, requests a second: this is within the limit, since only rentals other than closed count toward it.
